claims.statement: Create team is the submission action in the containing procedure. It gives no team name, membership, hierarchy, permission grant, successful creation receipt, or authorization to create a team.

The organization Access section leads to Organization roles and Role assignments; a new assignment is constructed by searching for users or teams and selecting a role, then submitted. Definition and assignment are separate operations; this fragment supplies no eligible recipient check, actual granted permissions, effective access verification, or privilege-change authority.

Custom-role creation requires a name and description followed by permission selection and submission. The pinned org-custom-role-with-repo-permissions feature applies to GHEC and GHES >=3.15: that branch separates Organization and Repository tabs, permits inheritance from a repository base role and subsequent additional permissions, and labels repository role/permission inclusion public preview subject to change. The other branch uses a permissions text-field selection. The release-phase variable resolves to public preview. These branches do not prove feature availability on a live target, accepted privilege combinations, complete base-role semantics, or successful creation; linked permission guides remain separate review work.

Custom-role deletion is selected from the role-actions menu and requires reading the confirmation dialog before submitting deletion. The first step describes the role as one to edit even though the operation is deletion; that wording is retained as a source mismatch, not silently recast as editing. The fragment does not define assignment fallout, reversibility, or a successful deletion receipt; no role was deleted.

Custom-role editing uses the role-actions menu, changes the role and submits Update role. Updating a shared definition is not evidence of reviewed downstream access changes, effective assignment verification, rollback, or authorized mutation.
Role-assignment views may optionally be filtered through Users or Teams tabs. A filter is not a complete assignment inventory, an assignment/removal operation, or proof of permissions.
